openQuestions: Quote provenance: for Probation Service and Irish Prison Service the quotes came through WebFetch, which extracts via a model; both sites fail certificate verification when fetched directly. They were returned as exact copies but not independently re-checked. For all other bodies I read the page text directly. Do you want the Probation and IPS quotes re-gated, or set to paraphrased?

Irish Prison Service: its own About page says it deals with offenders 18 or over (verdict none), but the Department of Justice youth-justice page (last updated April 2024) says the Minister is responsible 'via the Irish Prison Service for the small number of remaining children in adult prison facilities'. Record the IPS as none on its own documents, or as part on the sponsor's statement?

Courts Service and Legal Aid Board: both administer or fund the legal process in child care proceedings, but the Courts Service does not decide cases and the Legal Aid Board's help goes to the adult who defends the application (the page says 'defend'). Arts Council 'via': set to schools because Creative Schools is the child programme read, but it also has a child protection tool for arts organisations (sign-in; unread). Keep via schools?
Charities Regulator is unverified because its site returns a bot challenge to every automated request. Needs a hand check or another route; I did not bypass it.

Dormant Accounts Fund: the 2026 Action Plan table has more child/youth rows under the Departments of Children, Disability and Equality, Education and Youth and Health than are recorded here.
